图片内文字：
- Data Source: Beijing Claims Database
- Coverage
- ~ 8,000
- designated medical institutions
- Institutions
- > 19 million
- Insured persons
- Population
- Covers nearly 8,000 designated medical institutions
  - Includes 765 hospitals (135 tertiary, 177 secondary, 405 primary); 2,143 community health centers and other health institutions¹
- Covers all clinical and medication data of more than 19 million insured persons from insurance-billed healthcare visits, including outpatient/ inpatient, emergency, and external pharmacies
- Data scope & value
  - Comprehensive patient journey tracks full treatment pathways from diagnosis to prescriptions across inpatient, cross-institutional, and external settings
  - Representative of the total population in Beijing
  - Accurate & timely data: medical settlement updated within T+2 days; medical records updated within T + 3 months
  - Medical insights: helps reveal changes in clinical practice and identify clinical unmet needs
  - Limitation: only has payment records of test; does not have the results of the tests
- Boehringer Ingelheim
- 1. 北京市卫健委《2023年北京卫生健康事业发展统计公报》

视觉关系：
- 页面分为两块信息区：上半部分为“Coverage”，下半部分为“Data scope & value”。
- “Coverage”区中左侧给出两个覆盖规模指标（~8,000 designated medical institutions；>19 million Insured persons），中间以两段对应标签呈现（上：Institutions；下：Population），右侧两段项目符号分别对应上述两项覆盖说明（机构覆盖说明对应~8,000；人群与就诊数据覆盖说明对应>19 million）。
- “Data scope & value”区以项目符号列表形式并列呈现5条数据范围/价值与限制点，无流程箭头与先后顺序标注。
